Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) using double-tagged proteins (Flag-HA). Acquisition is DDA based on the description of isolating and fragmenting specific precursor ions in an LTQ Velos. Quantification is explicitly listed as peptide counting in PRIDE metadata. While the paper discusses ubiquitination of PKM2, this was analyzed via Western Blot, not by MS-based diGly enrichment; the PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset'.

cell_lines: We used retroviral transduction strategy to establish NIH/3T3 cell lines expressing double-tagged proteins.
the TBL3 cell line was derived from in vitro infection of the spontaneous bovine-B lymphosarcoma cell line, BL3

scope: Double-affinity purification was performed using HA-Flag antibodies from NIH/3T3 control (empty pREV vector) and Flag-HA-hPin1 stable cell lines.
Both fractions were then subjected to a two-step immunopurification with Flag and HA antibodies
To search for Pin1 interactors, we expressed ectopic, tagged Pin1 in fibroblasts and performed immunoprecipitation followed by mass spectrometry analysis
